subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as public metadata-only plugin manifest fields for macOS Computer Use discovery?
rationale: The request is additive and aligned with manifest-first discovery, but it creates plugin API surface tied to app-owned Accessibility and Screen Recording permission decisions.

options.title: Accept after owner confirmation
options.body: Confirm field names, metadata shape, docs, and permission semantics in the linked PR before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape
options.body: Change or narrow the manifest fields before they become a shipped plugin-author contract.

options.title: Pause for host design
options.body: Leave the issue and PR open until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish the manifest surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Confirm field names, metadata shape, docs, and permission semantics in the linked PR before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to prior manifest-contract ownership and this choice needs plugin API plus host permission-boundary judgment.
